ablation.name: local_t26_ll_ycbcr
ablation.notes: T26: Plan H YCbCr-style LL color decorrelation. Paradigm-level change after Plan E/F/G (mean/std/cov all harmful). 结构性解耦 LL 为 luma (channel-mean, 亮度图) + chroma (deviation, 色彩偏差). 只迁移 chroma 协方差, 完全保留 luma (逐像素 HxW, 非仅 mean 标量). 关键区别 vs Plan G: Plan G 保留 4 标量 mean 迁移 FULL 4x4 cov; Plan H 保留 HxW luma map 只迁移 3D chroma 子空间 cov. 假设: LPIPS 完全中性 (亮度图不动), CLIP 可能受益 (色彩关系迁移). 目标: clip>0.7213 AND lpips<0.2868 (dual beat T11).
